bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 位于所有均线上方，仍低于 $271.5–275.3

read.en: Amazon rose 0.5% on Nov 12 to $267.44, trading $267.21–273.60 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($266.1), 10-day ($259.4), 30-day ($256.4), 100-day ($253.7) and 200-day ($244.5), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($240.65), and RSI is 58.2.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月12日上涨 0.5%，收于 $267.44，盘中区间 $267.21–273.60，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$266.1）、10 日（$259.4）、30 日（$256.4）、100 日（$253.7）和 200 日均线（$244.5）上方，均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$240.65），RSI 为 58.2。

read.en: No level changed: the $273.60 high stalled again under $275.3, and the $267.21 low stayed above support. Resistance is $271.5–275.3 (recent highs), then $278.6 (May 5 high) and $287.2 (52-week high). Support is $263.9–266.1 (5-day, Nov 4 and 11 lows), then $258.5–259.4 (Nov 6 low, 10-day) and $253.7–256.4 (30 and 100-day). A close above $275.3 would target $278.6; below $263.9, $258.5–259.4.
